title: Layouts: five questions that choose a layout, with column demos

set.request: Design the layout decision system: an ordered list of judgement questions (space, content + outline, horizontal fill, which approved layout), live demos of the column principles (equal height, one short column, the centred title fix, small vs large content), the questions into the layout skill, and one worked run through ask-each. Owner words: ai/2026-09-28/organization/owner-words.md, 11:15 PM.
set.now: demos built and shot; skill updated; waiting on ask-each for the worked example
steps: Read owner words and what exists
Add the questions to the layout skill
set.outcome:
**Choosing a layout is now five questions, asked in order, with live demos: [/layouts/decide/](/layouts/decide/).**

![The five questions at 1920](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/choosing-a-layout-five-questions-and-col/questions-1920.jpg)

- [x] Ordered questions, worded as judgement with examples: [/layouts/decide/](/layouts/decide/) (room, content, outline, fill the width, which approved layout)
- [x] Three equal columns: [equal](/layouts/decide/equal/), pictures at 1920 and 3440
- [x] One short column, to show the mismatch: [short](/layouts/decide/short/)
- [x] The fix, the title centred vertically: [centred](/layouts/decide/centred/), one existing word and no new CSS
- [x] A little content against a lot: [amount](/layouts/decide/amount/) (preview cards, then a left nav)
- [x] Questions in the `layout` skill: a new section, 'Choosing a layout (before sizing)', C1 to C5. Nothing was removed.
- [x] Run through ask-each on a real page: [worked example](/layouts/decide/servex/). It asked about /framework/servex/ one question at a time, cost $0.91, and picked a Tile wall.

Review: reviewed: 8 fixed, 2 declined ([review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/layout-system/review.md)). The smoke test was clean and the branch is merged into michael/dev. Card: [Choosing a layout](/framework/ai/2026/09/29/choosing-a-layout-five-questions-and-col/).

Left out: a separate Next/Next walkthrough. The /layouts/decide/ page already leads from the questions to the demos in order.
